label: Political Prisoners
contestNote: Foro Penal narrow count: ~200–250 after 300-person release May 19–24 including 23-year detainees Bolívar, Rovaín, and Molina. Broader estimates: ~800 political prisoners remain per ABC News (June 2026). Government Amnesty Law claims 8,600+ beneficiaries since Jan 8; Foro Penal verified only ~91 released under the Amnesty Law specifically. Released prisoners face mandatory security check-ins and speech restrictions. Rodriguez government has resisted setting an election date, and human rights groups note continued politically motivated arrests alongside releases.
delta: −490+ from 2024 peak; releases ongoing under Amnesty Law; hundreds still detained
